title: Andrés Gómez Emilsson's DMT accounts at the Psychedelic Science conference

tellings.quote: I was speaking just a few days ago in Denver at psychedelic science conference with um Andres Gomez Emilson.

plain: At a psychedelic science conference in Denver in 2025, a man named Andrés Gómez Emilsson is said to have shared accounts of experiences on DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug that some users say takes them to other worlds. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore mentions it to Michels, saying he had spoken alongside Gómez Emilsson in Denver "just a few days ago," though he gives little of what the accounts contained. Gallimore brings it up as part of his case that DMT may open a door to an alien realm.
